rule: DISP-STK-237 la ban ghi DEV-authored. No chot authority va bien quyet dinh thanh rang buoc chay duoc, nhung KHONG thay the approval. Chi khi approval_state = APPROVED va du moi truong bat buoc thi disposition moi co hieu luc.

required_approvals.subject: Approve hoac reject DEFERRED / NO-GO cho variance query-report o MVP v1.12 hien tai (WWHN-25, WWHN-60, WWHN-237, WWHN-238).
Xac nhan khong mo Change Request nang pham vi MVP cho variance o release nay; WWHN-238 chuyen Deferred / N-A thay vi Blocked.
Pin effective disposition va rebaseline AC cua WWHN-60 / WWHN-237 / WWHN-238 theo REQ-SRS-037; go trich dan BRD-Handoff v3.9 khoi AC.

source_authority_inputs.role: INPUT — khong co hieu luc chung nao chua co effective date

source_authority_inputs.location: Jira attachment — khong nam trong repo
source_authority_inputs.role: INPUT — approver phai trich dung attachment id nay trong comment duyet
source_authority_inputs.note: Gate khong the hash mot file khong co trong repo. Bang chung la comment approver-authored tren Jira co trich ATT-11898 + cap SHA o CANDIDATE_PAIR.json.

source_authority_inputs.role: TARGET — ba ticket duoc rebaseline theo ket qua duyet

outcome_when_approved.WWHN-238: DEFERRED / N-A cho MVP v1.12 — khong de Blocked, khong de Pending
outcome_when_approved.WWHN-60: AC lien quan variance query-report khong con hieu luc, cho BA rebaseline

outcome_when_rejected.next: Neu authority doi sang Later Phase / CR co effective date thi DEV237-P1-03R2 mo lai o dang positive implementation; luc do disposition nay bi superseded bang mot decision record moi tro toi no, khong sua noi dung.

how_to_record_approval: 1. Approver comment tren WWHN-237, ghi ro: quyet dinh (APPROVE/REJECT), ATT-11898, cap SHA BE/FE lay tu docs/evidence/WWHN-237/CANDIDATE_PAIR.json, va effective date.
2. Dien slot tuong ung trong file nay: approver, approver_role, jira_comment_ref, decided_at, decision.
3. Khi ca 3 slot APPROVED, dat approval_state = APPROVED + effective_date + effective_disposition.
4. Chay lai `node scripts/verify-wwhn237-variance-report-disposition.mjs` — check APPROVAL-AUTHORITY fail-closed neu thieu bat ky truong nao hoac neu approver trung vai tro DEV.
